text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, Jan 14 - Chittagong - 29 Vessels in port of which 7 containers, 1 bitumen, 2 logs, 6 general cargo, 3 48 hours, 1 cement, 1 fertiliser, 1 export loader, 2 tankers, 2 scraping, 3 other vessels. 23 Vessels due of which 5 containers, 4 general cargo, 1 48 hours, 3 fertiliser, 1 tanker, 3 food grain, 1 salt, 1 cement clinker, 4 other vessels. Berthing delays, 3 days for containers, 2-3 days for general cargo.

INDIA, Jan 14 - Bombay - No labour problems. Six vessels loading at berth, 22 discharging at berth. 3 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 15 waiting to discharge, 1 bunkering, 1 under repair, 2 awaiting orders. Berthing delays, containers/general cargo vessels 2-3 days, bulkers 12-14 days. Calcutta - Eight vessels loading at berth, 17 discharging at berth, 1 bunkering. 12 Vessels due (2 coking coal, 5 products tankers, 5 containers). Cochin - No labour problems. One vessel loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth. 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 5 waiting to discharge. 1 Oil tanker at dry dock, 1 vessel at shipyard jetty for repairs/fitting. 7 Vessels due with up to 1 day delay expected.

Mormugao - Labour working normally. One vessel discharging at berth, 3 loading at anchorage, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting to discharge. 3 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 2 awaiting orders, 11 due with 4-5 days delay expected. Kandla - Five vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 1 loading at anchorage, 8 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge. 3 Tankers. V/Jetty IOC - 1 Vessel, 12 waiting. 10 Vessels due with following delays, rice/general cargo/g. blocks 10-12 days, containers 2-3 days, ckd 1-2 days. Mangalore - No labour problems. Three vessels loading/discharging at berth, 6 awaiting berths, 1 under arrest, 9 due with 3-4 days delay expected.

Madras - No labour problems. Four vessels loading at berth, 9 discharging at berth (1 logs, 1 wood-pulp, 1 scrap, 1 rock phosphate, 3 coal, 2 other vessels). 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load. 11 Waiting to discharge (2 thermal coal, 1 sulphur, 1 mop, 4 containers, 1 scrap, 2 other vessels). 29 Vessels due by 13/1 of which 8 general cargo, 2 edible oil, 3 coal, 8 containers, 2 panamax, 1 lube oil, 1 fertiliser, 1 chemicals, 3 other vessels. Berthing delays expected, coal/coke 4-5 days, fertiliser/other vessels 3-4 days, scrap 5-6 days, no delays for containers/iron ore. Jawaharlal Nehru - No labour problems. Three vessels discharging at berth (1 tanker/iron ore, 2 fertiliser/raw materials). 1 Tanker waiting at anchorage to load, 2 vessels waiting to discharge (1 tanker/iron ore, 1 fertiliser/raw materials). 3 Vessels due (1 fertiliser/raw materials, 2 tankers/iron ore) with 10-15 days berthing delay expected for fertiliser/raw materials.

Repair work after the fire has progressed so that port authorities expect one conveyor system to be made available for discharging food grain by the end of January. Paradip - Labour working normally. Two coal vessels loading at berth, 1 coal discharging at berth. 7 Vessels due of which 2 coal, 1 chrome, 1 iron ore, 2 oil, 1 gas/chemicals. Delays expected, oil 2 days, coal up to 1 day. Tuticorin - No labour problems. Two vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 2 due with no delays expected at present. Visakhapatnam - Seven vessels discharging at berth, 10 loading at berth. 17 Vessels due of which 5 export (1 steel plates, 1 wire coils, 2 granite blocks, 1 alumina powder). 12 Import (2 coking coal, 2 timber logs, 1 sulphur, 1 magnetite, 1 containers, 1 fused magnetite, 1 rock phosphate, 1 phosphoric acid, 1 sun flowers, 1 general cargo). Delays expected, steel plates/wire coils/granite blocks/timber logs/sulphur/magnetite/rock phosphate 7-8 days, coking coal 10-12 days, sun flowers 3-4 days, general cargo 5-6 days, alumina powder/containers/phosphoric acid up to 1 day.

MALAYSIA, Jan 15 - Port Kelang - North/south port container/ro/ro berth - 7 Vessels berthed, 8 waiting with 3 days waiting time expected. Deep draft conventional wharf - 3 Vessels berthed, 2 due 15/1, 1 waiting with 1 days waiting time expected. Dry/cement bulk terminal - 2 Vessels berthed, 3 waiting with 4 days waiting time expected. Liquid bulk terminal - 4 Vessels berthed, 6 waiting with 2 days waiting time expected. West port - Container/ro/ro berth - 2 Vessels berthed, 1 waiting with 1 days waiting time expected. Deep draft conventional wharf - 5 Vessels berthed, 2 waiting with 2 days waiting time expected. Cement bulk terminal - 2 Vessels berthed, 1 waiting with 2 days waiting time expected. Liquid bulk terminal - No vessels, no waiting time.

MAURITIUS, Jan 14 - Port Louis - Port labour working normally. Two container vessels berthed discharging/loading, 2 general cargo vessels berthed discharging. No idle vessels, 1 vessel dry-docked. Fishing port - 8 Vessels of which 5 discharging, 3 bunkering.

PAKISTAN, Jan 13 - Karachi - Four rice vessels loading at berth, 5 container vessels loading/discharging. 13 Vessels discharging (general cargo, phosphate, urea, sugar, fish, vehicles, base oil, fuel oil, hsd). 2 Rice vessels waiting at anchorage to load. 17 Vessels waiting to discharge (containers, fertiliser, oil tankers, sugar, hsd). 3 Vessels awaiting orders, 1 awaiting crew change, 11 due with 2-3 days delay expected. Port Qasim - Five vessels loading at berth (rice, steel slabs, wheat, sugar). 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (fuel oil, wheat).

SIERRA LEONE, Jan 14 - Freetown - No labour problems. For security reasons, vessels should endeavour to be in/out of port before 19.00 hrs. Four vessels berthed, all dischargers, of which 2 rice, 1 containers, 1 aid cargo. 1 Cargo vessel anchored under arrest. 5 Vessels due of which 1 vehicle discharger, 1 oil discharger, 3 container dischargers.

SINGAPORE, Jan 13 - Singapore - Tanjong Pagar container terminal - 11 Container vessels berthed. Keppel terminal - 12 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang terminal - 10 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang terminal - 1 General cargo vessel berthed. Jurong port - 2 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessels berthed. Oil terminals/sbm buoys - 19 Tankers berthed. Minimal berthing delays at all terminals/ports/buoys.

SOUTH KOREA, Jan 14 - Inchon - 65 Vessels in port (42 berthed, 23 anchored) of which berthed, 7 logs, 7 corn, 4 steel, 3 general cargo, 3 containers, 3 pig iron, 2 coils, 2 pulp, 1 steel, 1 steel plate, 1 molasses, 1 red beans, 1 soya bean meal, 1 timber, 1 palm oil, 1 ply-wood, 1 h-beams, 1 raw sugar, 1 silica sand. Vessels anchored, 4 containers, 3 wheat, 3 cars, 3 coils, 2 logs, 2 general cargo, 1 ply-wood, 1 scrap, 1 pulp, 1 soya bean meal, 1 timber, 1 talc. Approx. 1-2 days delay expected. Busan - 167 Vessels in port (48 berthed, 119 anchored including 60 laid-up) of which berthed, 33 general cargo, 8 containers, 4 scrap, 3 coal. 59 Vessels awaiting berths, with approx. 2 days delay expected.

Pohang - 17 Vessels in port (13 berthed, 4 anchored) of which discharging, 2 billets, 2 coils, 2 scrap, 1 coal, 1 pipes, 1 chrome. 4 Steel vessels loading, 4 vessels awaiting berths, with approx. 1-2 days delay expected. Ulsan - 25 Vessels in port (22 berthed, 3 anchored) of which discharging, 4 chemicals, 1 fertiliser, 1 feed meal, 1 mono ethyl glycol, 1 urea, 1 salt, 1 rock phosphate, 1 corn, 1 copper concentrate, 1 wood-chip, 1 crude oil, 1 lpg. Vessels loading, 3 general cargo, 2 chemicals, 1 fertiliser, 1 base oil. 3 Vessels awaiting berths, with approx. 2-3 days delay expected. Masan - Five vessels in port (all berthed and all discharging) of which 2 logs, 1 steel scrap, 1 steel coils, 1 pig-iron. No berthing delays expected.

SRI LANKA, Jan 14 - No labour problems. Colombo - 11 Vessels loading at berth (2 essential services, 8 containers, 1 general cargo). 21 Discharging at berth (3 bagged sugar, 2 bagged rice, 4 perishable goods, 1 bagged fertiliser, 8 containers, 1 bagged maize, 1 steel, 1 bulk cement), 1 cruise liner, 1 bagged rice vessel waiting at anchorage to discharge. 7 Container vessels waiting to discharge/load, 1 vessel bunkering, 2 under repair, 4 dry-docked, 1 awaiting orders. 7 Container vessels due, berthing delays of 2-3 days expected for conventional vessels. Trincomalee - One vessel loading at berth.

TAIWAN, Jan 11 - Keelung - Four vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 6 days, meal 5 days, steel 4 days, iron ore 2 days. Kaohsiung - Four vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 1 day, iron/coal, 2 days (csc berth), coal/scrap, 2 days. Public berth), steel 1 day. Taichung - Six vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 3-4 days, iron ore/coal/scrap/steel/others, 1-2 days. Jan 14 - Kaohsiung - 69 Vessels in port of which 12 containers, 9 tankers, 2 grain, 3 other bulkers, 31 general cargo. 12 At buoys, 18 general cargo vessels waiting at outer anchorage, with 2 days berthing delay expected.
